head: cc-slaves {v}
impact.busy: The app waits for {n} running {n:turn|turns} to finish, then restarts; messages sent meanwhile are held and sent after.
impact.idle: The app restarts as soon as the download is done.
laterNote: No reminder for {v} — you can still update in Settings → Engine
wait.title: Waiting to update · {m} min
wait.installed: Installed {v}, restarting once the turn ends
wait.cancelNote: Stop waiting: send the {n} held {n:message|messages} now, no update.
inst.title: Installed {v}. Restart to use the new version.
err.signature: The {v} package does not match its signature, so it was not installed.
err.wait: Lost the engine connection, so the wait stopped. Held messages were sent; nothing was installed.
retryOffline: Wait for the engine to reconnect, then try again
remoteHold: The Mac is waiting to update — messages you send are held
